info.title: YEET Social API
info.summary: Developer API for autoposters, AI agents and integrations
info.description: Same HTTPS/JSON interface the Yeet app uses. Authenticate with an approved developer key (Authorization: Bearer yeet_sk_…). Keys act as their owner, restricted to scopes (read, write:posts, write:interactions) and per-key rate limits (default 60/min, 2000/day). Value-moving and account endpoints are never reachable with a key. Human docs: https://justyeet.it/api.html

tags.name: keys
tags.description: Key management uses the app session (JWT), not the key itself; whoami uses the key.

apiKey.bearerFormat: yeet_sk_… (developer key) or app session JWT

automation_kind.description: Set for posts created through an API key: autoposter | ai | other

content.description: May be empty only for kind=audio

get.description: Returns the presented key's id, kind, scopes and owner. The first call to make.

post.description: Requires a verified e-mail. The key is pending until approved by the Yeet team.
Posts created with a key are stored with automation_kind = key kind and labelled in the app.
JPG/PNG/WebP/GIF ≤ 8 MB, MP4/WebM ≤ 32 MB (≤ 60 s), audio ≤ 80 MB (≤ 60 min). File signature must match the declared type.
